Input images: Image 1 is the locked identity standard; Image 2 is the approved adult proportion/style pair; Image 3 is the approved recent attack body artwork. Preserve the same character and rendering style.
Primary request: Draw EXACTLY 8 full-body figures, a strict 4 columns x 2 rows sheet, 2560x1440, genuinely transparent background. Every figure is at IDENTICAL anatomical pixel scale. Top-left is the mandatory tall fully upright neutral ruler. The other 7 figures are ONE quiet ready breathing pose and SIX phases of a COMPLETE WALK cycle facing SCREEN RIGHT. Leave generous transparent gutters and fully contain all hair, boots and sword tips. No ground shadow, no labels, no effects.

1 neutral ruler fully upright (arms relaxed, feet under hips, SAME scale as others).
2 ready breathing inhale, knees slightly soft, grounded.
3 walk near/right leg forward heel-contact, far/left leg back toe-off.
4 walk near/right leg supports below pelvis, far/left leg swings forward with knee bend (passing).

Six phases MUST include genuine right-left leg exchange, not six identical stances and not a mirrored whole character. Anatomical scale, head size and camera fixed. Coattails trail gently, no huge billowing. Crisp dark outline, restrained cel-shaded painted material gradients matching references. No watermark, typography, panel borders, UI.
